name: multitq_kpct_amendment_LC1_A1_llm_controls_gpu_sharing
status_at_registration: No GU_5 or GPLAIN_1 training output, checkpoint, dev or test prediction exists (no GPU job of this track has been submitted).
trigger: About 48 GB of the memory of the GPU card used by this track is held by other long-running processes. The frozen recipe peaks at ~84 GB in training (train_stats peak_mem_gb of G_1 / GU_1 / GU_10: 84.1 / 83.8 / 84.1) and reserves 85% of the card in vLLM, so it does not fit next to them.
implementation_changes: Training (GPLAIN_1 and GU_5): the frozen gk_train.py option --grad_ckpt (gradient checkpointing, non-reentrant) because other processes hold ~48 GB of the card's memory. The optimisation is unchanged: same LoRA config, optimizer, LR schedule, effective batch 16, micro-batch token limit 8,192, data order, epochs and seed; checkpointing recomputes activations (RNG state preserved, so LoRA dropout masks are the same) and changes only memory and speed.

vLLM sessions and robustness passes: gpu_memory_utilization 0.40 (frozen default 0.85) via the frozen --gpu_mem option of gk_run_arm.py / gk_infer.py; this changes only the KV-cache size (scheduling/batching), not decoding (greedy, 48 tokens, max_model_len 2,304). GPU decoding is not bitwise batch-invariant, so this is declared.
unchanged: Everything else in LC1: arms, inputs, targets, renderer, selection on dev_sel2000, freeze-before-score discipline, analyses, robustness design, human-audit removal lists, stop rules, outputs.
